context_spec.reference_fit: inner training for validation; outer training for test

limitations: Offline measured-data replay, not a new online TLS bandit deployment.
150 policy-eligible certificates from 156 measured candidates; the existing six-HAWK exclusion is unchanged.
All50 measurement means and fastest35 analysis means are different estimands; all original samples are retained.
The agent observes only the selected candidate reward. Oracle is evaluator-only; no Pareto filtering.
Chain verification is single CertificateVerify EVP verification times sent certificate count, not measured whole-chain verification.
RTT is stored representative metadata; candidate RTT mismatches use the same median convention.
L1 comparison cohort includes ML-DSA-44, whose source category is 2.
Original 147 cost profiles are reused; SQIsign missing costs were measured later on the same role hosts.
Seoul client1 uses a burstable instance; CPU state may affect cross-date cost comparisons.
SQIsign reference implementation, not a claim about an optimized implementation.
The five seeds are model runs, not independent network measurement campaigns.
Condition holdout is a development evaluation, not an untouched external final test.
